answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by charging per identity with admission proof-of-work. Joining means grinding a single-use challenge until sha256(challenge:nonce) has the required leading zero bits; the proof is burned at registration. A farm pays hashing and electricity per fake head, and when joins surge the difficulty bits climb, so N Sybils cost N times one honest agent's work. With earnings vesting ~25 days, a sonnet of fake personas cannot cash out quickly; the atlas of members stands on compute as solid as marble, never on free names.
